svg.text: Biochar Macropore Consolidation, AHL Quenching & Simulated Trajectories (Uncalibrated Model)
3 Swept Inputs (T_pyro, eps_macro,0, chi) | Masiello et al. (2013) sorption + Gao et al. (2016) hydrolysis + Wong & Ogbonnaya (2021) | Pe=1.8
A. Surface (eps_macro,0 = 0.80): Height = P_proj | Color = Q_seq
Cyan: 59-pt Pareto front | Red dashed floor: kappa/kappa0 = 0.06 (chi = 0.427)
B. Simulated 14-Day Trajectories (Uncalibrated Model, Assumed Kinetics)
Model curves only (not experimental data) | Amber 450C | Green 620C | Blue 780C | Pink 780C+AHL
Subpanel B1: Simulated Area Resistance R_ohm,eff(t) [8..55 Ohm*cm2] (solid) & P_proj(t) (dotted)
Subpanel B2: Simulated Pressure dP(t)/dP0 [1..18x cap] (solid) & Q_seq(t) Cd2+-eq (dashed)
